items.title: Germany news: Solar power production approaches record high
items.description: Solar power output in Germany in 2026 has already surpassed that in all of last year. Meanwhile, experts say the country is headed for a budget crisis. DW has more.

items.title: Trump to meet Xi, Putin for three-way huddle on nuclear arms talks
items.description: The White House has said President Donald Trump will urge Xi Jinping and Vladimir Putin to discuss cutting nuclear arsenals in Shenzhen next week, though a senior US official expects no agreement.
